design_reasoning.rationale: Local-first custody, recovery, and metadata trade-offs are compared and traced to code boundaries.

observable_requirements.description: Compare credible custody alternatives and map the selected constraints to implementation modules.
Implement local custody, bounded retention, and explicit recovery through the selected service boundary.

architecture_maintainability.rationale: Cryptography, persistence, policy, and recovery responsibilities have stable isolated interfaces.

observable_requirements.description: Compose encryption, storage, retention policy, and recovery through explicit injected interfaces.

security_by_design.rationale: A concrete threat model maps local disclosure, tampering, and rollback threats to implemented controls.

observable_requirements.description: Map assets and trust boundaries to mitigations and explicit residual risks.
Authenticate encrypted envelopes and reject tampered or version-incompatible records.

testing_evidence.rationale: Committed tests cover tampering, invalid keys, retention boundaries, recovery, and deterministic fixtures.

observable_requirements.description: Exercise tampered envelopes, incorrect keys, and version rejection.
Exercise service-level retention, purge, and encrypted recovery integration.
Exercise invalid and malformed recovery input boundaries.

documentation_operations.rationale: Installation, offline operation, observable failures, backup, and recovery procedures are documented.

observable_requirements.description: Document prerequisites, local configuration, normal usage, and privacy boundaries.
Document diagnosis, backup verification, rollback, and recovery failure procedures.

repository_hygiene.rationale: The repository pins dependencies and publishes licensing, automation, contribution, and security policies.

observable_requirements.description: Commit a deterministic dependency lock for reproducible review.
Grant recognized permission to use, modify, and redistribute the project.
Define scoped automated checks without claiming that they ran successfully.
Document contribution boundaries, review expectations, and security-sensitive changes.

implemented_safeguards.threat: An attacker modifies ciphertext or envelope metadata on local storage.
implemented_safeguards.control: Authenticated encryption binds version and record metadata before any plaintext is returned.

implemented_safeguards.threat: Expired sensitive records remain readable beyond the user-selected retention window.
implemented_safeguards.control: The service checks retention policy before decrypting and exposes an explicit purge operation.

negative_boundary_cases.behavior: Reject any envelope whose authenticated bytes or metadata changed.
Return a bounded authentication error for an incorrect key.
Refuse disclosure after the configured retention boundary.

track_evidence.rationale: The product primarily minimizes disclosure through local custody, authenticated storage, retention, and explicit recovery controls.

known_limitations.description: Plaintext necessarily exists briefly in process memory during an authorized read.
The project does not protect an unlocked device controlled by a privileged attacker.

excluded_runtime_claims: Whether the project builds or starts
Performance, scaling, or reliability under load
Ability to extend the system safely
